name: Table Header Scope Attribute
description: Provides a text filter plugin that sets the scope attribute on table header HTML-elements.
project_description:
In a table, the scope attribute indicates the direction and range of data cells covered by 
 elements. This module provides functionality to automatically set the scope attribute for these table header cells.

 Features 
 The Table Header Scope Attribute module provides text format filters that process 

 

 elements to improve accessibility:
 
 Set scope attribute for table headers : Automatically sets the correct scope attribute on 
 elements based on their position in the table. 
 Transform empty table header to table data : Converts empty 
 elements into 
 elements, as empty headers provide no semantic value. 
 
 For example, the following table:

 

 
 
 
 
 Column header 1 
 Column header 2 
 
 
 
 
 Row header 1 
 Value A 
 Value B 
 
 
 Row header 2 
 Value C 
 Value D 
 
 
 
 

 Will be transformed into:

 

 
 
 
 
 Column header 1 
 Column header 2 
 
 
 
 
 Row header 1 
 Value A 
 Value B 
 
 
 Row header 2 
 Value C 
 Value D 
 
 
 
 

 Post-Installation 
 After installing this module, you can enable its functionality:

 
 Go to Administration » Configuration » Content authoring » Text formats and editors 
 Edit a text format, for example, "Basic HTML" 
 Enable both filters:
 
 "Set scope attribute for table headers" 
 "Transform empty table header to table data" 
 
 
 Ensure the filters are ordered correctly:
 
 Set scope attribute for table headers" must come before "Transform empty table header to table data" 
 Both filters should be below the "Limit allowed HTML tags and correct faulty HTML" filter 
 
 
 
 Assuming the filters are enabled for a text format that can be used on, e.g., a basic page (node). Create or edit a basic page, then add a table. Indicate the 
 elements in the 

 

 and save the node. When viewing the (source of the) basic page, the scope attributes are correctly set to the 
 tags.
